title: Dispatches from O'Reilly: Inside a software factory
summary: Go from vibe coding to generating clean, maintainable code
llm_summary: "Dispatches from O'Reilly: Inside a Software Factory" explores how modern development teams can move beyond ad‑hoc, “vibe‑coding” to a disciplined, production‑line approach that consistently churns out clean, maintainable code. The piece highlights practical tools, processes
